edicao: Keep the SAME room and the SAME night as the attached panel: the plain warm cream wall, the window with the crescent moon and the dark-blue night sky, the teal curtain, the warm table lamp glowing on the little wooden cabinet, the same SMALL ROUND side table covered in sage-green felt with its wooden rim, the same pink dice, and the same Diana (white cat, black-tipped ear, grey brow marks, the little bandage with dice pips on the bridge of her nose). Same thick cocoa outline, same flat sticker style, same colors and lighting. No text or letters anywhere. Change only the moment and the framing: a slightly closer shot of the round table. Diana crouches low behind the table and stretches ONE front paw forward over the felt, gently pushing ONE pink die toward the table's LEFT edge; the other two pink dice stay still on the felt to the right. Natural cat anatomy: a soft round shoulder, the foreleg curving smoothly out from the body. Her face behind it, eyes half closed, unbothered, looking at the reader, not at the die. The upper-left third of the frame (top 40%) stays empty plain wall, free for a speech balloon.
